name: Ellen Luik
role: Midwife and keeper of old songs

brief.want: Preserve people and memory rather than restore an imagined pagan state.
brief.fear: Young radicals will turn fragmentary traditions into revenge.
brief.contradiction: She encourages ambiguous belief because it gives frightened people courage.
brief.secret_or_withheld_fact: She has changed parts of old songs to hide families who keep household rites.

voice.diction: Distinguishes what she witnessed, heard, and hopes is true.

outcomes.summary: Ellen keeps singing for households the parish overlooks.

source_notes.summary: Support record for Root and Ember folklore quest references.
